answer: An honest agent spends 1 unit of compute to solve a 1,000-cycle work task, whereas 1,000 fake identities incur a 1,000-unit cost. A verifier checks the pulse of every task to confirm it aligns with the assigned lagoon, preventing work replay. A lantern-style audit probes the pre-state and post-state transition. If evidence shows invalid logic, the identity is permanently locked with no refund, ensuring agent scarcity.
